questions.question_text: The quartic function $y=(x+1)(x+2)(x-3)(x-1)$ crosses the y-axis at...

options.why: Evaluates one factor or misses the product of all four factors at zero.
Uses only the positive factors and omits the two negative factors.
Treats the factor $x-3$ as the whole value at the y-axis.

questions.solution_text: At the y-axis $x=0$. Thus $y=(1)(2)(-3)(-1)=6$, so the intercept is $(0,6)$.
